partnerPrograms.title: Technology partners
partnerPrograms.who: ATS, HRMS, assessment and background-check providers
partnerPrograms.body: Build a supported connection to TalentPool365 using the REST API and webhooks, and list it for our shared customers.

partnerPrograms.title: Implementation partners
partnerPrograms.body: Roll the platform out for enterprise customers: process design, data migration, rubric workshops and training.

partnerPrograms.title: Referral & reseller partners
partnerPrograms.body: Introduce TalentPool365 to your clients, or resell it as part of your own service under a commercial agreement.

partnerSteps.title: Tell us about your business
partnerSteps.body: Use the form on this page. A partner manager replies within two business days.

partnerSteps.title: Agree the fit
partnerSteps.body: A short call to confirm the programme, the customers you serve and the commercial terms.

partnerSteps.title: Get enabled
partnerSteps.body: Sandbox access, training and certification for your team.

partnerSteps.title: Go to market together
partnerSteps.body: Joint plan, shared pipeline and a named contact on our side.
